projects.name: Signal
projects.title: Signal — RAG Support Assistant
projects.desc: An LLM-based support assistant that answers product questions from live documentation, with cited sources and a confidence threshold that escalates to a human. Retrieval runs over a chunked, embedded copy of the docs that re-indexes nightly, so answers never drift from the current release. Every response carries inline citations back to the source page, and anything the model is not confident about is handed to a human agent with the conversation context attached rather than guessed at.

projects.name: Flowline
projects.title: Flowline — Ops Automation Suite
projects.desc: An automation layer connecting CRM, email, and internal tools, cutting manual ticket triage by roughly 40% for a 15-person ops team. Incoming requests are classified, enriched with account history, and routed to the right queue before anyone opens them. Failed runs retry with backoff and surface in a run-history view, so the team can see exactly what fired and why.

projects.name: Forecastr
projects.title: Forecastr — Demand Prediction
projects.desc: A time-series forecasting model and API used to plan inventory across three regional warehouses, reducing overstock by double digits. Forecasts are regenerated weekly and served behind a FastAPI endpoint the planning team calls directly from their existing tooling, with backtest accuracy tracked per warehouse so drift is caught before it reaches a purchase order.

projects.name: Ledger
projects.title: Ledger — Warehouse & Reporting
projects.desc: Nightly ingestion into a modelled warehouse with tested transformations, replacing a fragile set of hand-run scripts. Every table carries freshness and row-count tests, so a broken upstream feed fails loudly instead of quietly reporting stale numbers.
